title: Task schema migration and rollback evidence
minimumPromotionPolicy: Task schema rollback promotion requires versioned JSON descriptors, current/older/corrupt/unknown fixtures, legacy row visibility, packaged owner isolation, backup/restore evidence, Safe downgrade behavior, and stable diagnostics before live task mutation is promoted.

schemaContract.legacyVisibilityPolicy: legacy TimedTask rows remain visible to Rhino and can be represented only as immutable NodeTimedTaskSnapshots

rollbackContract.safeProfileDowngrade: ignore Node task descriptors and keep legacy Rhino rows visible
rollbackContract.proProfileDisable: disable future Node task rows without deleting legacy TimedTask rows
rollbackContract.packagedDowngrade: remove or disable only rows owned by the packaged app identity
rollbackContract.corruptionRecovery: quarantine corrupt descriptors, emit stable diagnostics, and avoid scheduler reschedule
rollbackContract.unknownSchemaRecovery: preserve unknown future descriptors without mutation until a compatible migrator exists
rollbackContract.legacyVisibility: legacy Rhino task UI remains the source of truth for legacy TimedTask rows

readyEvidence.meaning: P14-18 reserves current, older, legacy, corrupt, unknown, and packaged owner-mismatch schema fixtures.
P15-12 keeps task_database unpromoted and provides the v1.3 JSON-safe mutation dependency gate.
The task_database provider remains provider_poc until implementation, device, packaged, disclosure, rollback, security, type, docs, Safe downgrade, and raw-object denial evidence all pass.
The task_database provider declares rollback proof paths, Safe downgrade, packaged downgrade, task-removal, relaunch, and crash recovery requirements.
P15-13 owns P14-18 under pro.tasks_device_media with migration_rollback_fixture evidence.

openBlockers.requiredEvidence: Runtime migration tests for current, older, corrupt, and unknown descriptor versions with stable pass/fail diagnostics.
Corrupt descriptor recovery evidence proving quarantine, no scheduler reschedule, and no legacy row deletion.
Safe downgrade and Pro disable evidence proving legacy Rhino TimedTask rows remain visible and Node descriptors fail closed.
Packaged rollback evidence proving packaged task rows are removed or disabled only for the owning package identity.
Backup and restore fixture evidence for legacy rows, future Node descriptors, packaged descriptors, and downgrade cleanup.
Provider-disable Safe downgrade proof that task rows are preserved or disabled according to owner policy.
Cross-package rollback denial evidence proving packaged apps cannot mutate or delete main-app or legacy Rhino rows.
P15-22, P15-23, P15-25, and P15-26 sync before task schema rollback can be marked promoted.
